Thanks Ben / Elena — I started the vendor record in our AP system but need two items to complete bank verification and approve electronic payments: 

1) A bank letter on company letterhead or a scanned voided check (we prefer a bank letter for wires).
2) Confirmation of the vendor tax ID (please confirm the EIN matches the attached W9; I'll cross-check).

Elena — can you provide the bank letter and a contact at your bank (name + phone) for verification? If possible, please add the company billing address to the reply so our ERP has a matching remit address.

Once we receive the bank letter and confirm the EIN, I will:
- Complete vendor setup in Netsuite
- Create vendor record and attach W9
- Configure payment methods: ACH + Wire (both enabled)
- Enter initial PO-2026-1189 and queue wire transfer upon approval

If you need the PO to be signed before the wire, confirm and we will expedite internal approvals.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Vendor Operations
redwood.com
